newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank says injecting funds on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank says injecting funds on Friday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank, responding to recent tight liquidity in the money market, said it would inject funds into the banking system on Friday.

A central bank official said the bank would execute open market operations on Friday through repurchase of negotiable certificates of deposit, treasury bills, and government bonds offered by interested financial institutions.
The institutions have the option to repurchase the NCDs, treasury bills and bonds within 10 days, the official said.
The central bank said interested financial institutions should contact the bank directly.
Accepted rate was 7.150 percent, and application would close at 10.30 a.m. (0230 GMT), the central bank said.
Funds would be released according to actual demand, it said.
